responsibility: Declares the shared pragma infrastructure for C-family front ends. It defines the built-in pragma and OpenMP/OpenACC clause enums, exposes the global cpplib reader, declares registration and invocation APIs for normal and early pragma handlers, and provides lexer/utility interfaces used by pragma parsers and related preprocessing code.
same_name_distinction: Shared pragma interface header: it defines pragma_kind and clause enums, handler typedefs, registration APIs, and lexer entry points, while c-pragma.cc implements the actual pragma parsers, registration storage, and invocation behavior.
